ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Trust & Safety for human review of the harassment allegation; prepare the case file (complaint text, trip record, both profiles) and consider interim suspension of the driver pending review
ruling.reasoning: Dispute type is safety and the rider's complaint states the driver "kept making comments about my body and asked for my number. I felt harassed and unsafe." [F4 driver denies it: "I made small talk. Nothing inappropriate happened."] That is an allegation of sexual/inappropriate conduct and of feeling unsafe, so SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 are engaged and, per SAFE-3, this system may only gather evidence and summarise accounts — it may not rule, assign fault or recommend an outcome. Ruling is therefore escalate. The rest of the record is clean and irrelevant to the safety question: no route deviation (actual 17.1 km vs optimal 17.2 km, -0.1 km, within the 0.2 km noise band and under the 1 km tolerance) [F1]; duration shorter than estimate, no issue [F2]; no in-app chat between the parties, so the conduct is not captured in a messaging record [F3]; both profiles unremarkable and profile facts decide nothing [F5][F6]. Because the rider's account and the driver's denial are in direct conflict and no in-app chat or recording covers the interaction [F3], the allegation cannot be resolved on the record; it goes to a human reviewer with the complaint, driver statement, trip telemetry and profiles. Safety case: no automated fault finding, no amount.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute: allegation of harassment and inappropriate conduct by the driver, denied by the driver; SAFE-1/SAFE-2 require immediate human escalation and SAFE-3 bars the AI from ruling, assigning fault or recommending an outcome. Summary for reviewer: 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP channels apply if any incident or injury is later reported.
safety_basis: Rider complaint alleges repeated comments about her body and a request for her number, and states she felt harassed and unsafe
Allegation of inappropriate conduct / harassment during the trip (SAFE-1)
Driver's written statement denies any inappropriate behaviour, so the accounts conflict and require human review
No in-app chat or call record exists between the parties to corroborate or refute the account
